throughline.zh: 本週台灣與東南亞的供應鏈資訊涵蓋載板、封測與光學引擎的擴產目標、矽電容晶圓驗證、記憶體設計研發、勞資協商，以及廠務電力、設備材料和工程人力條件。
throughline.en: This week's Taiwan and Southeast Asian reporting covers substrate, test and optical-engine capacity targets, silicon-capacitor wafer validation, memory design R&D, labor talks and factory power, equipment-material and engineering workforce conditions.

title.zh: 先進封裝與高速互連：載板、光學引擎、矽電容及材料
title.en: Advanced packaging and interconnect: substrates, optical engines, silicon capacitors and materials

summary.zh: 台灣展會和NVIDIA、聯電及愛普公告揭露載板、晶片測試、CPO光學引擎與矽電容的新驗證或擴產節點；矽品規劃2027年中將光學引擎產能提升至現有15倍，愛普Gen2D已完成初步晶圓驗證。馬來西亞及泰國則有銅箔、CCL與焊球產能規劃，相關認證和實際產出仍待公開。
summary.en: Taiwan industry disclosures added capacity and qualification milestones for substrates, testing, CPO optical engines and silicon capacitors. SPIL targets a 15-fold optical-engine increase by mid-2027 and AP Memory completed initial Gen2D wafer validation, while Malaysian and Thai materials expansions remain subject to qualification and actual output.

title.zh: 晶圓製造與電子需求：訂單、出口和電力負載
title.en: Wafer production and electronics demand: orders, exports and electric load

summary.zh: 台灣9月外銷訂單達1,142.1億美元、馬來西亞同期出口年增54.5%，台綜院另報9月半導體用電年增11.55%。三組數據的地域、統計範圍與基期不同，半導體用電無法直接換算為晶圓出貨。
summary.en: Taiwan's September export orders reached US$114.21 billion, Malaysia's exports grew 54.5% year-on-year, and the Taiwan Research Institute reported 11.55% growth in semiconductor electricity use. Geography, bases and definitions differ; power consumption cannot be converted directly into wafer shipments.

title.zh: 記憶體：美光勞資進度與馬日ZAM設計合作
title.en: Memory: Micron labor developments and Malaysia-Japan ZAM design collaboration

summary.zh: 美光台中工會10月21日達成協議，桃園工會22日有11名幹部展開行動；公司另公布季度分潤及台灣勞退提撥調升。馬來西亞SkyeChip與日本SAIMEMORY合作新型記憶體架構研發，尚未公布樣品良率或量產計畫。
summary.en: Micron reached a Taichung union agreement on October 21 and 11 Taoyuan union officers began strike action on October 22, when Micron also detailed compensation changes. Malaysia's SkyeChip joined Japan's SAIMEMORY memory architecture R&D, without prototype yield or production timing disclosures.

title.zh: AI資料中心系統：台灣ODM與模組化機房交付
title.en: AI data-center systems: Taiwan ODMs and modular deployment

summary.zh: 神雲台灣擴廠、東南亞機房計畫與NVIDIA DSX POD新型模組化AI機房依不同進度推進，DSX POD列名鴻海、台達電、技嘉、和碩、雲達及緯創等合作廠商。最快14天部署是備妥案場條件的公司估算，與已上線機房容量不能混用。
summary.en: MiTAC's Taiwan factory program, Southeast Asian site plans and NVIDIA's modular DSX POD reference design represent distinct stages. Taiwan partners include Foxconn, Delta, GIGABYTE, Pegatron, QCT and Wistron, while the 14-day prepared-site target is an estimate rather than installed data-center capacity.

title.zh: 擴廠執行條件：施工、設備材料、人才與電力
title.en: Capacity execution: construction, tool materials, talent and power

summary.zh: 台積電高雄F22工地事故造成4名工人死亡並暫停同類作業；Reuters另報導台積電正洽詢設備馬達降低稀土使用量，尚未獲原廠證實。新加坡製造AI補助與馬來西亞半導體人才培訓資金均為計畫或核准支出，與實際產線投產不同。
summary.en: Four workers died at TSMC's Kaohsiung F22 site, prompting suspension of similar work, and Reuters separately reported preliminary, unconfirmed inquiries into rare-earth alternatives for fab motors. Singapore's manufacturing-AI support and Malaysia's semiconductor training approvals are program measures, distinct from commissioned factory capacity.
